description: Returns our order page with the report and countries filled in. Fees: Country $99 per country, Enhanced $199 for one country, Global $299. Payment opens only when the person chooses to pay there, so send only countries and the tier, never personal details.

countries.description: The countries to order for, as names or ISO codes, for example ["NL", "United Kingdom"]. Only countries we cover.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

tier.description: "country" (one or more countries), "enhanced" (exactly one country) or "global" (every country the person worked in).

name: create_order_link
title: Get an order link for a report
